record.label: Logical spacetime volume in qubits and T gates
record.statement: The logical spacetime volume is the product of the peak number of logical qubits and the total $T$-gate count. For comparisons, the authors price clean-ancilla Toffoli gates using the four-$T$ construction.
record.boundary: The 25-bit instance uses 100 logical qubits and at most $3{,}698$ primitive $T$ gates. In Appendix F.2, the authors estimate the cost of the Häner et al. baseline at a working width of 35 bits. Its estimated maximum error is about $10^{-6}$, dominated by the square-root calculation in Häner et al.’s Fig. 6. The conversion from logical spacetime volume to physical runtime and qubit count depends on the architecture.
